audit.whatIsWrong: Three sources give three different level charts and I could not resolve which is authoritative, so no chart edits are proposed. Urgot's packet chart is Skill/Urgot/Gnar/Gnar/Urgot/Gnar/Urgot; the page's enum rows are Gnar/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Gnar; the already-audited mirror records Gnar/Gnar/Gnar/Skill/Urgot/Urgot/Urgot.
audit.why: The content whys[] prose on this page already tracks the packet chart (level 2 yours, 3-5 Gnar's, 6 yours, first item Gnar's, 2+ items yours), while the enum rows are mostly 'Skill' and the mirror is a third answer. Flipping six rows on a guess would ship a chart a paying user will trust, and the instructions forbid guessing, so this is escalated instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on either form's tools.
audit.why: Boomerang Throw is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s and refunds part of the cooldown if he catches it; Hyper and Mega's Wallop are both 7s; Hop/Crunch is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s; GNAR! is 90/60/30s. Your side: Purge 12s down to no cooldown and no cost at rank 5, Disdain 16s at rank 1, Fear Beyond Death 100/85/70s.
audit.corrected: The cooldown breakdown and the do-line now carry GNAR!'s 90s, Wallop's 7s and Hop's 22s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats GNAR! as a flat 'Mega all-in' and blames 'Mega-E' for the wall stun. The wall stun belongs to GNAR! (R), not to Crunch (E).
audit.why: Riot's text: GNAR! throws everything around him in a chosen direction, and 'any enemy that hits a wall is stunned and takes bonus damage'. In open ground it is a displacement and slow with no stun, which changes where you are willing to stand. Crunch is a leap that deals area damage on landing — no stun.
audit.corrected: report[5].t now states the wall condition, and the don't-title names Mega's R rather than Mega-E.

audit.why: The supplied missing-interaction ('Gnar can deny your mobility, Corrosive Charge (Q), with GNAR!') rests on the kit file's 'dash' flag on Corrosive Charge, which contradicts Riot's own description — Q fires an explosive charge at a location and moves Urgot nowhere. Disdain is his only mobility. Per instruction the description wins, so the interaction was not written to the page.

edits.before: Mini Gnar kites your range — poke him, respect Mega’s all-in. Urgot wins by trading around Gnar's GNAR! (Mega Stun) and cashing the pattern: poke mini form, save E for Mega.
edits.after: Fight the Rage bar, not the champion: mini Gnar has no stun at all, Mega has Wallop on 7s and GNAR! on 90s at rank 1. Trade while the bar is low and hold Disdain for the transform.

edits.before: - Gnar GNAR! (Mega Stun): matchup-defining — His Mega all-in. Don’t fight transform. Track it before every engage. - Gnar GNAR!: Mega only: knocks up + slows; against a wall it stuns long. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - GNAR!: 90/60/30s, Mega only. It only stuns if you are thrown into a wall, so fight in open ground. - Wallop: 7s Mega stun, his real trade opener. - Hop/Crunch: 22s at rank 1 — once he has jumped he is stranded for it.

notes: Kit-flag misfire: Urgot's Corrosive Charge (Q) carries a 'dash' flag but Riot's text gives it no movement — Disdain (E) is his only mobility. The supplied missing-interaction for this matchup depends on that bad flag and was therefore not written. Not asserted: whether Boomerang Throw's return leg can be blocked, and how much cooldown he refunds by catching it — Riot's text says only 'its cooldown is reduced'.
